info.name: Course search (POST /api/courses/:courseId/search)
info.description:
Course search: one course's classes, course PDFs ("Ebooks") and tests, ranked by title.
Local server on feat/course-search, prod data read-only (see reference/postman/course-search.README.md).
Signed-in requests mint their own JWT with the LOCAL jwt_secret — point {{base}} only at the local
server, never at prod.

item.name: 1 Guest
item.description: No token. Guest defaults on every class; no test attempts.

exec: pm.variables.set('cid', pm.variables.replaceIn('{{course_id}}'));
const res = pm.response.json();
pm.test('guest query: 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
const d = res.data || {};

pm.test('guest query: exactly the three sections, all arrays', () => { pm.expect(Object.keys(d).sort()).to.eql(['classes', 'ebooks', 'tests']); ['classes', 'ebooks', 'tests'].forEach((k) => pm.expect(d[k]).to.be.an('array')); });
const max = Number(pm.variables.get('limit'));
pm.test('guest query: every section within the limit (' + max + ')', () => ['classes', 'ebooks', 'tests'].forEach((k) => pm.expect(d[k].length, k).to.be.at.most(max)));

item.name: 2 Signed in
item.description: Valid token for {{user_id}}: same matches, per-student watch state from the token.

exec: pm.variables.set('cid', pm.variables.replaceIn('{{course_id}}'));
const b64u = (w) => CryptoJS.enc.Base64.stringify(w).replace(/=+$/, '').replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_');
const enc = (o) => b64u(CryptoJS.enc.Utf8.parse(JSON.stringify(o)));
const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
const sign = (payload, secret) => { const h = enc({ alg: 'HS256', typ: 'JWT' }); const p = enc(payload);
return h + '.' + p + '.' + b64u(CryptoJS.HmacSHA256(h + '.' + p, secret)); };
const payload = { user_id: pm.variables.get('user_id'), email: 'postman@local', mobile: '0', iat: now - 120,
exp: now + 3600 };
pm.variables.set('token', sign(payload, pm.variables.get('jwt_secret')));
const res = pm.response.json();
pm.test('signed in: 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
const d = res.data || {};

pm.test('signed in: exactly the three sections, all arrays', () => { pm.expect(Object.keys(d).sort()).to.eql(['classes', 'ebooks', 'tests']); ['classes', 'ebooks', 'tests'].forEach((k) => pm.expect(d[k]).to.be.an('array')); });
